why: One registry for what this tree is checked with and by what, so the same fact stops living on four sides of the repository. Every tool pin is stated once here and asserted against the file that actually uses it; every make target is a gate or is not, with the question it answers; every CI job is named. tests/Architecture/ToolchainRegistryContractTest.php fails on any drift in either direction, so a new gate, a new job or a version bump cannot happen silently. Read by `make gates`.
